SCROLL

Recording is proof of presence. A fleeting moment, an echo of something that will never return. Before the sound—breath, silence, broken voice, even the noise we never meant— all of it holds meaning. So reach into the depths of imagination, and weave a sound that echoes deep within every soul.

capture

Recording Studio

A deep bench of outboard, vintage through modern. The live room is voiced to hold a natural decay rather than go dead, so drums, horns, strings and whatever else you bring keep their own sound. Two isolation booths cover vocals and amps, which means a three-piece — drums, bass and guitar — can cut it live in one take.
